# Aliya Trading

> > Aliya Trading is a Manila-based international trading company offering automotive parts, medical supplies, agricultural products, industrial materials, and consumer goods across the Philippines and global markets.

Operating from Manila, Philippines, Aliya Trading serves as a manufacturer, exporter, and distributor specializing in diverse product categories including JDM automotive engines (Toyota, BMW, Bentley), EN455-compliant medical nitrile gloves, agricultural commodities, petroleum products, and industrial materials. The company emphasizes affordable pricing and quality assurance across its international supply chain.

- Aliya Trading
